scope: Wiki audit evidence only; implementation and production Wiki were not changed

mode.http: real ASGI routers; browser tests use isolated real servers
mode.curator: deterministic decisions and terminal stand-in; real WikiWorker/storage/grants/receipts

phases.name: coverage-boundaries
phases.failure_classification: four App boolean parsing discrepancies, grouped under existing CR-12

cost_method.counters: section-list iterations, source-file opens, SQLite connection total_changes and VM steps sampled per 100
cost_method.timing: instrumented times are diagnostic, not production p95 or provider usage
cost_method.wide_job: actual WikiJobs progress updates in batches of three; no model/receipt/body work is included
cost_method.guide: current working-tree guide bundle includes a preexisting query-v2.md change

move_observation_probes.classification: observed watcher guarantee limitation; not a new CR-18 count; no hash-based identity inference is requested

prepared_run_errors: Initial external pytest collection omitted project configuration; later invocations select pyproject.toml explicitly
Initial small smoke moved into an unobserved newly created directory; isolated follow-up confirmed identity loss even with periodic sync
Move continuity probes remain failed under the stronger expectation; results were not changed to pass
coverage_limits: No real model content quality or paid provider usage measurement
Hard kills cover Wiki history/store writer processes, not the entire server/worker/model/notification chain
Disk faults are targeted syscall injections, not actual power loss or a full disk
No proof of exhaustive operation permutations, arbitrary multiwriter/source-graph/network combinations, or production latency/memory bounds

document_verification.review_document_whitespace: passed; intentional two-space Markdown breaks preserved
